calls.name: install-agent
argv:
set -eu
echo old=$PPID
test "$(shasum -a 256 /tmp/testanyware-agent-k195 | cut -d" " -f1)" = 76e76a484edd59c80075ea40982412e4e1932dc926c433a40e9c3789a05c6bcf
rm -f /tmp/testanyware-exit-trace.jsonl
sudo -n install -m 0755 /tmp/testanyware-agent-k195 /usr/local/bin/testanyware-agent
test "$(shasum -a 256 /usr/local/bin/testanyware-agent | cut -d" " -f1)" = 76e76a484edd59c80075ea40982412e4e1932dc926c433a40e9c3789a05c6bcf
old=$PPID
export old
nohup sh -c 'sleep 2; launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/com.linkuistics.testanyware.agent || kill $old' </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 &
echo restart-scheduled

calls.name: verify-agent
issue-child
argv:
mkdir -p /tmp/taw-exec-reliability
sleep 120 & child=$!
printf '%s\n' "$child" > /tmp/taw-exec-reliability/child.pid
printf 'partial\n' > /tmp/taw-exec-reliability/partial
wait

calls.name: after-04-threads
argv: ps -axo pid=,ppid=,user=,comm= | grep -i anyware; agent=$(ps -axo pid=,comm= | awk '$2 ~ /testanyware-agent$/ {print $1}' | paste -sd, -); printf "agent pids=%s\n" "$agent"; ps -M -p "$agent"

calls.name: after-07-identity
argv: shasum -a 256 /usr/local/bin/testanyware-agent; sw_vers -productVersion; uname -m; sysctl hw.ncpu hw.activecpu kern.wq_max_threads kern.wq_max_constrained_threads

calls.name: cleanup
argv:
state() {
  if err=$(kill -0 "$1" 2>&1); then echo alive
  else case "$err" in *[Nn]o\ such\ process*) echo gone ;; *) echo unknown ;; esac; fi
}
wait_gone() {
  i=0
  while [ "$(state "$1")" = alive ] && [ "$i" -lt "$2" ]; do
    sleep 0.1; i=$((i + 1))
  done
}
outcome=confirmed
for f in /tmp/taw-exec-reliability/child.pid /tmp/vmfit-k15/timeout.pid /tmp/vmfit-k15/cancel.pid; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  pid=$(cat "$f")
  cmd=$(ps -p "$pid" -o command= | sed 's/ *$//')
  printf '%s pid=%s command=%s\n' "$f" "$pid" "$cmd"
  if [ "$cmd" != "sleep 120" ]; then
    s=$(state "$pid")
    if [ -z "$cmd" ] && [ "$s" = gone ]; then printf 'gone pid=%s\n' "$pid"
    elif [ -n "$cmd" ] && [ "$s" = alive ]; then printf 'other pid=%s\n' "$pid"
    else printf 'unknown pid=%s state=%s\n' "$pid" "$s"; outcome=uncertain; fi
    continue
  fi
  kill -TERM "$pid"
  wait_gone "$pid" 20
  action=terminated
  if [ "$(state "$pid")" = alive ]; then
    kill -KILL "$pid"; action=killed
    wait_gone "$pid" 5
  fi
  s=$(state "$pid")
  if [ "$s" = gone ]; then printf '%s pid=%s\n' "$action" "$pid"
  else printf 'survived pid=%s state=%s\n' "$pid" "$s"; outcome=uncertain; fi
done
printf 'cleanup %s\n' "$outcome"
[ "$outcome" = confirmed ]
